profile.name: Hadryan Rizky Dimas Saputra
roles: Undergraduate Informatics Engineering Student at Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember (ITS)
profile.summary: I am an Informatics Engineering student at Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember (ITS) with a deep interest in robotics, computer vision, and systems engineering. Currently, I serve as a programmer for the Banyubramanta ITS Robotics Team, where I focus on developing control logic and simulations for Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUV) and Remotely Operated Vehicles (ROV).  My technical toolkit includes C++, Python, and ROS 2, alongside hands-on experience in computer vision using YOLO and OpenCV. I enjoy the challenge of bridging the gap between hardware and software, whether it is through Gazebo simulations or building robust backend systems with FastAPI and PostgreSQL.  I am driven by technical precision and the goal of becoming a professional System Engineer. I thrive in collaborative, multidisciplinary environments where I can apply data-driven insights to solve complex engineering problems.  Feel free to connect with me here or reach out via email at dimassaputraa779@gmail.com.
